audience: developers and GIS analysts who use the MapTiler Cloud API for geocoding, elevation and coordinates

useCases.title: Find coordinates for a place or address, or the reverse
useCases.text: The AI searches a place or address by name and returns matching locations as GeoJSON. It can also find the place at a longitude and latitude.

useCases.title: Geocode a list of addresses in one go
useCases.text: The AI geocodes up to 50 queries in one request and returns one result set per query, in order. It saves time on short address lists.

useCases.title: Look up the elevation of points
useCases.text: The AI reads ground elevation for up to 50 coordinates. You can compare heights of summits or route points.

useCases.title: Convert coordinates between coordinate systems
useCases.text: The AI transforms up to 50 coordinate pairs from one EPSG system to another, and searches the CRS database by text or filters such as code or kind.

useCases.title: Read the features of a hosted dataset
useCases.text: The AI fetches the GeoJSON features of a MapTiler-hosted dataset by its data id. You can then inspect or summarize the points and shapes.
